_worker_isolation_notes.problem: All Railway services in the devoted-courtesy project share the same GitHub repo. Without watch paths, any push to main triggers ALL services to redeploy, even when only one service's files changed.
_worker_isolation_notes.solution: Configure watch paths in the Railway dashboard for each service. The watchPaths above specify exactly which files each service depends on. Only changes to those files should trigger a redeploy of that service.

service_map.qb-proxy-server: Main API server (Dockerfile). Serves all /api/v1/* routes + QB proxy.
service_map.reminder-worker: Background reminder worker (Dockerfile.worker, CMD: node reminderWorker.js). Processes appointment reminders via Gmail.
service_map.calendar-outbox-worker: Calendar sync worker (Dockerfile.worker, CMD: node scripts/calendarOutboxWorker.js). Syncs appointments to Google Calendar.
service_map.crm-frontend: Frontend (separate project/service, crm-frontend/Dockerfile). Served by nginx, no backend.

railway_service_name_mapping.qb-proxy-server: Backend API (same name in both places)
railway_service_name_mapping.insightful-encouragement: Frontend CRM SPA (crm-frontend) — NOT a backend worker
